plugins.description: Claude Code plugin for oh-my-mlip, five skills behind one registry: /oh-my-mlip:setup installs+verifies a model env on your GPU; /oh-my-mlip:run executes single-point predictions; /oh-my-mlip:catbench runs adsorption benchmarks and builds the comparison report; /oh-my-mlip:finetune converts your dataset and drives the framework's own fine-tuning; /oh-my-mlip:distill orchestrates teacher-to-NN-MTP distillation down to a CPU LAMMPS student. Deterministic by design — every executed command exists on disk first.
